_notes.charityNumber: TEMPORARY PLACEHOLDER. Not valid. Never published while registrationStatus is 'pending' (the build fails if it leaks).
_notes.howToGoLive: When the Charity Commission issues the real number: set charityNumber to it and registrationStatus to 'registered', then push to main.
_notes.formEndpoints: Contact form: paste the Web3Forms access key (public by design) into web3formsAccessKey. Newsletter: paste the beehiiv subscribe-form embed URL (the iframe src) into beehiivEmbedUrl. While empty, both fall back to mailto. contactFormEndpoint is an optional generic override.
